# Using Maestro in Claude / Claude Code

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Claude / Claude Code.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.claude/skills/maestro/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.claude/skills/maestro/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness claude --skill maestro
node packages/cli install --harness claude --skill maestro --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Claude / Claude Code loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also run it explicitly by typing `/maestro`.

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.claude/skills/maestro` for a project install, or `~/.claude/skills/maestro` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `maestro` is listed.

## Notes

- Nested .claude/skills folders inside subdirectories also load when working there.
- Maestro delegates every step. Load the model preferences and the provider catalog before choosing a worker. Paseo can drive Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cline, Cursor, Kilo, Hermes, Antigravity, Muse, and ACP providers. Read references/harness/adapters.md before the first spawn, and record the worker chat id before the first prompt.
- Claude Code subagents run through the Task or Agent tool. For a chat you can re-enter, use claude -p --session-id <uuid> and claude -p --resume <uuid>.
- Documentation: [Claude / Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) (path source: official).
